answer.reason: Independent knowledge of North Dakota's industry composition supports the correction. North Dakota's total covered employment is roughly 470,000 (about 390,000 private), and Professional, scientific, and technical services (NAICS 54) is not a dominant sector there — Fargo (Cass County) and Bismarck (Burleigh County) account for most of it, with a statewide total historically in the ~16,000–18,000 range. A figure of 27,174 would imply NAICS 54 is ~7% of all private covered employment in North Dakota, which is implausibly high for NAICS 54 alone (that magnitude better fits a broader professional-and-business-services grouping or a different series/geography). A December (month 3) 2024 private-sector month3_emplvl of 17,068 for NAICS 54 is consistent with the known scale of this industry in the state, matching the user's verification of the cited QCEW CSV (2024 Q4, area 38000, NAICS 54, private ownership). The draft answer A should be corrected to B.
